about.title: About
about.line: Rare wood concierge. Slabs, logs and veneer, and special requests.
about.body: Captain0 is a family workshop in Piatra Neamț, Romania. We buy standing or fallen timber locally, mill it ourselves, and dry it in our own yard. Primary product is raw material: live-edge slabs, burl, blanks, and bookmatched pairs — especially European poplar burl (mappa), European walnut (Juglans regia), and European oak. We have been cutting and drying our own timber for [TBD] years. Finished epoxy river tables are made from the same stock; they show what the wood can do. They are not the main SKU.
